alignments.note: Connective particle rendered 'and', fronted in English (rule 15).
Substantival demonstrative expanded with the generic noun 'things'; the demonstrative stays the head (rule 17).

The supplied imperative has no licensing token in this verse: ἀγάπην's English ('love') is complete and no verb is expressed here, the governing imperative standing back at 3:12. Rule 103's licensing test therefore makes it `added` rather than a rule 7 helper. Folding it onto s006 remains defensible if the ellipsis is read as part of that noun's English.
The ASV writes no determiner for 'love' (rule 23).
Relative pronoun; SBLGNT.COL.3.14.v007 is underdetermined (r00-base, r01) and the English is indifferent.
Anarthrous predicate noun with supplied determiner as helper (rule 51).
Case preposition rides with the determinerless noun (rule 21).

review_notes: ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τούτοις is an adjunct rather than a predicate, so rule 62 does not put the supplied verb on the preposition; the verb is marked `added` under rules 5 and 103 with the competing reading noted.
The article at s005 is emptied by the ASV's bare 'love', not by any displacing possessive.
